Legal

Terms of Use

Effective Date: July 2026 Welcome to Abilene Vibes, operated by Abilene Labs. These Terms of Use apply to all users, visitors, businesses, advertisers, contributors, listing submitters, and anyone who accesses or uses Abilene Vibes. Free Use of the App

Abilene Vibes can be explored for free. You are not required to create an account to browse local businesses, events, marketplace listings, jobs, rentals, gallery photos, and other public content. Some features, such as submitting content, managing listings, saving items, interacting with content, or purchasing paid placements, may require additional information.

Submitted Content

When you submit content to Abilene Vibes, you are responsible for making sure it is accurate, lawful, appropriate, and that you have the right to submit it. Submitted content may include business listings, marketplace listings, job posts, rental listings, gallery photos, reviews, logos, images, descriptions, prices, contact information, links, and other details.

Permission to Use Submitted Content

By submitting content, you give Abilene Vibes permission to display, store, edit for formatting, publish, promote, and share that content in connection with the app. This may include use inside Abilene Vibes, related websites, social media, promotional materials, local advertising, and other Abilene Vibes channels.

Photos, Logos, and Images

You may only submit photos, logos, images, or media that you own or have permission to use. You are responsible for any rights, permissions, copyrights, trademarks, privacy rights, or publicity rights related to the media you submit.

Business submitters are responsible for providing accurate business names, categories, descriptions, addresses, phone numbers, websites, social links, photos, logos, and contact information. Featured and Premium Placements

Featured and Premium placements are paid promotional placements that improve visibility inside Abilene Vibes. Featured currently costs $19 per month. Premium currently costs $59 per month. Payment does not guarantee immediate publication. Paid listings may still require Admin review before appearing publicly. Paid placement does not guarantee sales, visits, calls, rankings, customer interest, applications, rentals, purchases, or any specific result.

Subscriptions and Payments

Featured and Premium placements are monthly subscriptions processed through Stripe. By purchasing a paid placement, you authorize Abilene Vibes and Stripe to charge the selected amount today and automatically each month until the subscription is canceled. Stripe may process payments under its own terms and policies. Abilene Vibes does not store full credit card numbers.

Cancellations

You may request cancellation of a paid subscription by contacting Abilene Vibes or through available Admin support. Cancellation stops future renewals. If a subscription is canceled at the end of the billing period, the paid placement may remain active until the current paid period expires. Immediate cancellation may remove the paid placement sooner.

Refunds

Payments for the current billing period are not automatically refunded after purchase. Refund requests may be considered on a case-by-case basis by contacting Abilene Vibes. Stripe or other payment provider policies may also apply.

Marketplace submitters are responsible for the accuracy, legality, price, condition, ownership, contact information, and availability of items they post. Users are responsible for communicating safely, following applicable laws, verifying items, and making their own decisions before buying, selling, meeting, or exchanging payment.

Users may be able to like, save, favorite, rate, or review content. Reviews and public feedback should be honest, relevant, and respectful. Abilene Vibes may moderate, hide, or remove reviews or interactions that appear abusive, fake, misleading, unlawful, spammy, or inappropriate.

Events shown in Abilene Vibes may be entered, selected, or published by Admin. Event information may change.
